headlines.description: Kerim Alajbegovic and Jérémie Boga scored stunning second-half goals as Juventus beat 10-man Napoli 2-0 at the Allianz Stadium to ease the pressure on head coach Luciano Spalletti.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alajbegovic and Boga stunners sink 10-man Napoli

headlines.description: Christian Pulisic scored as AC Milan bounced back from a shock Europa League defeat with a 2-1 victory away at Genoa on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pulisic scores again as Amorim's Milan bounce back with Genoa win
